fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the street.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency apparatus to reach the main residence and detached structure.
• Install a reflective sign or marker at the detached structure identifying it as a separate building on the property.
• Trim dense vegetation along the driveway to maintain a clear path wide enough for emergency vehicles from the street to the structures.
• Cut back vegetation that blocks sightlines between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Keep a gate or opening in the perimeter fencing accessible to allow responders to reach the rear of the property on foot.
• If the perimeter fence has a lock, install a key box or use a padlock that can be cut, and mark the gate location visibly from the driveway.
• Clear a walking path wide enough for responders carrying equipment between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Post the property address at the street in a location visible at night and when vegetation is dense.
• Identify a flat open area near the driveway that can serve as a staging area for equipment and personnel, and keep it free of stored materials and vehicles.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree clusters nearest to the structure to create more open space between the trees and the building.
• Separate individual trees within the clusters so their branches do not touch or overlap each other.
• Trim lower branches on scattered trees near the structure to lift the canopy off the ground.
• Cut back shrubs that are growing directly against or touching the structure.
• Mow or cut down ground vegetation close to the structure before it dries out seasonally.
• Clear any dead leaves, dry grass, or loose plant debris that has collected against the base of the structure.
• Remove or cut back vegetation along the rear of the property to allow a person to walk and move freely behind the structure.
• Keep the single driveway entry clear of overhanging branches and encroaching shrubs along its full length.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is visible to an approaching vehicle under smoky or low-visibility conditions.
• Move any stored materials, wood piles, or outdoor items away from the sides of the structure and into open terrain where possible.
